description: issue #679 (SP7): the declaration-slot rule covers struct CONSTRUCTORS as well as procedures, so with `sprites` active `struct tell`/`struct ask`/`struct each` each raise `ol-reserved-word` at the struct-name token. `struct` is one of the grammar's four declaration slots (spec/grammar.md:384), which is why this fixture is unaffected by maintainer ruling #833. Binding is free (`spec/grammar.md:390`) and is pinned by the sibling fixture reserved-bindings-with-sprites; this fixture owns the struct-constructor case, which is a declaration and collides. The sibling reserved-struct-without-sprites checks the same declarations with Sprites absent and expects the same diagnostics: `tell` is a built-in NAME whether or not its profile is claimed (`spec/grammar.md:412`). `message` is absent from the diagnostics below, as it is from its twin: this fixture does not set `compareMessages`, so the harness compares its diagnostics on identity alone (issue #1025) -- and supplying a `message` without that flag is now a fixture ERROR rather than silently-ignored data, so nothing can sit here asserting nothing.
